description: Mirror an image left-to-right, flip it upside down, or both (180 degrees) in PNG, JPG or WebP without EXIF leakage. Returns the flipped image as base64. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.002/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/flip-image.

fileContent.description: The file as base64 (a data: URI is fine)

fileName.description: File name with extension, e.g. report.pdf

format.description: Output format: same, jpg, png or webp

mode.description: h (mirror left-right), v (upside down) or hv (both)

name: flip_image
title: Flip Image API - mirror horizontally, vertically or 180 degrees
